text: Omalizumab was trialed from 2022-06-01 to 2023-01-15 and stopped due to no meaningful benefit.
Respirology review. Diagnosis: severe asthma with an eosinophilic phenotype.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY
Admitted 2025-12-26 with acute asthma exacerbation. Treated with IV methylprednisolone then oral prednisone 40 mg daily, to complete 7 days total.
Discharge diagnosis: severe asthma exacerbation.
Post-discharge visit. Finishing prednisone tomorrow. Breathing much better.
Asthma flare from pollen. Prednisone 50 mg x 5 days.
Absolute eosinophil count 450 cells/uL. Specimen drawn 2026-05-09.
Repeat CBC requested; specimen hemolysed, no differential reported.
Active medications: fluticasone furoate/vilanterol (Breo) 200/25 mcg one inhalation daily; salbutamol 100 mcg PRN; mometasone nasal spray 50 mcg 2 sprays daily.
